purpose: Prevent new canonical runtime and service surfaces from introducing polling loops, while explicitly tracking transitional pollers that must migrate toward event-driven, push, lease, or watch semantics.
invariants: New canonical runtime surfaces must not introduce polling when an event, push, lease, subscription, watch, or callback membrane is feasible.
Every remaining polling surface must be declared as transitional debt with an explicit migration target.
Heartbeat and TTL refresh are not equivalent to work polling and may remain when they only prove liveness.
A shared runtime must not hide domain-specific polling compatibility logic.

transitional_polling_surfaces.current_mechanism: blocking task wait/watch port with legacy polling compatibility still present elsewhere
transitional_polling_surfaces.target_mechanism: kernel-native task watch or subscription port
